title: NC-PLUS-TICKFAIL-criticality-2026-11-13T14: Auto-apply D1 schema migration so criticality_samples exists before tick runs
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** the backlog item PLUS-TICKFAIL-criticality-2026-11-13T14 was parked needs-code by the in-tick doer
**Done check:** cmd:python3 scripts/needs_code_bridge.py --probe PLUS-TICKFAIL-criticality-2026-11-13T14
**Status:** closed

Auto-apply D1 schema migration so criticality_samples exists before tick runs

Backlog done check: A fresh environment with no criticality_samples table runs one tick and the criticality step completes after migrations auto-apply

Triage: Auto-applying a D1 schema migration requires changes to the Worker's tick code or migration scripts; the in-Worker doer can only edit the backlog database, not code. | first step: Add a migration step to the tick handler that checks for criticality_samples and runs the CREATE TABLE migration before the criticality step.

Bridged from the backlog by scripts/needs_code_bridge.py (NEEDS-CODE-BRIDGE-1). The change is code, data or a test that a loop consumes; a document alone does not close it.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 26.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
